headline: Google Gemini for macOS gets voice control and Gboard transcription
summary: The AI assistant can now be activated by pressing the 'fn' key and offers Rambler-level transcription for voice commands.
details: Google's Gemini AI assistant is now rolling out advanced voice control features for macOS users, following its preview at I/O 2026. This update allows for a more integrated and hands-free experience on Apple's desktop operating system.

A key feature of this rollout is the ability to activate Gemini simply by pressing the 'fn' key on your Mac keyboard. This provides a quick and convenient way to interact with the AI without needing to open the application separately.

Furthermore, Gemini for macOS now includes Gboard-level transcription capabilities. This means that voice commands are transcribed with high accuracy, similar to the experience on Google's Gboard keyboard, ensuring that your spoken instructions are understood precisely.
This enhancement brings Gemini closer to a seamless integration within the macOS ecosystem, making it a more powerful tool for productivity and information retrieval for Mac users.
